tested_groups: new stratified evaluation only; prior option/parallel notices and six old failures are development regression controls
acceptance: micro precision > .95 AND micro recall > .85 on unmodified entire evaluation sample
fusion: one specialist + two independent search-intent views; each canonical validated; tag and direct-role majority independently. Up to four public tags. Direct-role index up to 20.
secondary: Report strict 3/3 unanimity for public tags with recall including every omitted tag. Role index always >=2 votes; default public tag result >=2 votes.
